exposure: maternal and health systems strengthening intervention
outcome: increased number of deliveries in health facilities
improved potential and effective access to antenatal care
cohort: The study participants were women aged 18-49 residing in households within health facility catchment areas in Bungoma County, Kenya.
finding: The health systems strengthening intervention, including provision of transport vouchers, decreased barriers to healthcare access, resulting in an increased number of deliveries in health facilities and improved access to antenatal care and quality of care provision.
